lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Organized grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately five primary horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns along the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Nodes of highest pixel intensity located at the intersections of faint vertical bands and three primary longitudinal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features running horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity upper margins to shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 15 discrete, low-contrast high-luminance spots localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single remora attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the mid-flank; small high-reflectance abrasions visible on the distal tip of the lower caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong vertical light-shaft interference (god rays) causing high-frequency luminance fluctuations across the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the specimen.
